rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both texts connect comprehensive natural-resource development and conservation to economic growth and national defense, assign supporting roles to Agriculture, Interior, and other Federal officials, and emphasize participation by private groups. The child substantially compresses and adapts this machinery from a government-led regional resources survey to support for a privately organized national resources conference. C23 has strong subject-matter and policy-language parallels but less closely matches the child’s combination of Federal staff assistance and private participation. C21 parallels the endorsement of a competent nonpartisan private group and anticipated Executive and congressional use of its conclusions, but concerns a different substantive field.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I believe the full and economical development of natural resources is essential to economic growth and national security.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the economic growth and stability of an area depends largely upon how its natural resources are developed ... projects which can make significant contributions to our national defense effort
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared framing links resource development with economic growth and national defense.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the better management of resources ... new sources, new technology and more rigorous conservation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: preparing recommendations for the development, utilization and conservation of those resources
shared_material.explanation: Both present coordinated development, utilization, management, and conservation as the central resources-policy task.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am asking the Secretary of Agriculture, the Secretary of the Interior, and other Federal officials concerned with resources to render appropriate staff assistance in preparing for the conference.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Identical letters are being sent to the Departments of the Interior, the Army, Agriculture and Commerce ... the agencies which will participate as members of the committee.
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C16’s multi-agency resources effort, retaining the especially relevant Agriculture and Interior roles while reducing formal committee participation to staff assistance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: private groups—including industry, agriculture, labor, conservation, education—has a considerable responsibility
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I want the committee to invite the ideas and help of local governments and private groups and individuals to the extent possible.
shared_material.explanation: Both expressly combine Federal participation with contributions from private groups in developing resources policy.
